channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike Krzyzewski | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike Krzyzewski from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Falk on Michael Jordan, Mike Krzyzewski, John Thompson
item.description:
“If you think I wanted to have a confrontation with Michael Jordan -- hell, no. But if you want to have a relationship with someone like that, or Mike Krzyzewski, or John Thompson, they have to know, at all times, when they ask you for your advice, that you’re never going to flinch, you’re not going to B.S. them, and you’re going to tell them exactly what you think.”

David Falk on Michael Jordan, Mike Krzyzewski, John Thompson, May 21, 2025. Source: Sports Business Journal.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
Adam Silver:

“Recently, I was at a meeting with Mike Krzyzewski, former coach at Duke, and he condensed it with this headline. He said, ‘We should educate people about the game, and celebrate the game.’Educate and celebrate. And I wish there was more of that.”

Adam Silver on Mike Krzyzewski, Apr 28, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
Kyrie Irving said on a Twitch stream.

“A lot of my peers laugh at me when I bring it up and some fans may not agree, but I was born in Australia. Team USA asked me to play for them when I was 17 or 18 ...I wanted to play for Australia, but it just didn’t happen. Coach K (Former Team USA coach Mike Krzyzewski) wasn’t going to let that happen either.”

Kyrie Irving on Mike Krzyzewski, Aug 21, 2023. Source: NBL.com.au.

item.title: Amile Jefferson on Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
Former Duke men's basketball captain Amile Jefferson has been added to the staff as the team's director of player development.

“This is an honor to be back at Duke and I'm so grateful to Coach Krzyzewski for considering me for this opportunity,”

Amile Jefferson on Mike Krzyzewski, Jul 23, 2021. Source: Duke University Blue Devils Official Athletics Site.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
USA Basketball’s Gregg Popovich on how it’s possible he hadn’t met Mike Krzyzewski until a few years ago:

“I’m a Division 3 guy at heart. That’s where I spent most of my time until I woke up one day in San Antonio and never left. We never played Duke when I was at Pomona Pitzer.”

Gregg Popovich on Mike Krzyzewski, Aug 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: James Worthy on Byron Scott, Nate McMillan, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
James Worthy:

“It’s funny, with so many players coming out of high school and one year of college, you're starting to see teams wanting college coaches and stuff like that, but right off the top of my head: I played with Byron Scott, so I know what he brings to the table. I know that he holds people accountable and he’s a defensive kind of genius when it comes to that. I like Nate McMillan. Nate McMillan spent some time with Coach K [Mike Krzyzewski] in USA/international basketball. I think he knows all the players that were on the team. He has a good rapport. But, I got to go with my good friend Byron Scott, if it was up to me.”

James Worthy on Byron Scott, Nate McMillan, Mike Krzyzewski, May 20, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
“It wasn’t something I expected. Jerry Colangelo and Mike Krzyzewski called and I thought it would be a great opportunity to learn. I am excited to be here. Any time you have the opportunity to be around great coaches and great players, you have to take it. And these are your opponents, I think you learn a lot from them, too. I followed Team USA from afar and was very curious to see what the inner workings are here.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski, Jul 24, 2013. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
“I am honored that Jerry Colangelo and Mike Krzyzewski have asked me to join the USA Basketball National Team coaching staff,”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Colangelo, Mike Krzyzewski, Jun 10, 2013. Source: USA Basketball.

item.title: Danny Granger on Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
“Coach (Mike Krzyzewski) is a great coach. I talked to him about it and as long as we were winning, I was happy.”

Danny Granger on Mike Krzyzewski, Sep 22, 2010. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Jay Triano on Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
It’s not as if they simply work on their own sets and systems and go out and play; every minute of every game is broken down in painstaking detail.

“Coach K (head coach Mike Krzyzewski) works extremely hard and watches and breaks down every game after we play,”

Jay Triano on Mike Krzyzewski, Sep 7, 2010. Source: Toronto Star.
